title: Remark
body_md:
The assumption that $X_0^N$ belongs to the open chamber is imposed only to avoid the additional diffraction condition needed for initially colliding particles. Such initial conditions can also be treated by imposing the corresponding condition from \cite{GraMal14}, but this is more naturally verified in individual examples.

    No separate assumption that $C_N(0)>0$ is needed in this regime. Indeed, under $X_0^N\in W_N$ and $N\geq M_\sigma+2$, the initial configuration contains at least $M_\sigma+2$ distinct points, whereas $x\mapsto x\sigma(x)$ has at most $M_\sigma+1$ distinct zeros. Consequently, $C_N(0)>0$ almost surely.
